about: Closed vocabulary for title registers and the house exhibit digest, taken from TARGET_SPEC.md Appendix A (A.3, A.5, A.6, A.7, A.8, A.9). Each slug names one row of those tables; the label is the row's wording. complete_guide.py refuses any value outside these lists, so a new term enters here first, with the Appendix A row it comes from.

title_companion_above.kicker: Kicker or eyebrow label above the title (A.3)
title_companion_above.other: Something else; say what in why

title_companion_below.subtitle: Subtitle (A.3)
title_companion_below.lead_in: Lead-in sentence or claim under a topic title (A.3, A.4)
title_companion_below.other: Something else; say what in why

exhibit_type.line: Line (incl. indexed, price, dual-axis, area to baseline)
exhibit_type.stacked: Stacked bar, column or area (incl. 100%, diverging)

data_shape.no_data_shape: None of the A.7 shapes (an image wall, big numbers, structured text); say what in why

message_kind.other: None of the A.7 message kinds; the message field says it

annotation_move.highlight_one_mute_rest: Highlight one item, mute the rest
annotation_move.callout_to_insight: Callout box, arrow or leader to the insight
annotation_move.end_or_direct_labels: End or direct labels instead of a legend
annotation_move.numbered_keys: Numbered or lettered keys tied to text
annotation_move.data_rows_under_chart: Data rows or a table aligned under the chart
annotation_move.event_markers: Event markers on a time axis
annotation_move.bracket_or_brace: Bracket or brace (often with a sum)
annotation_move.inset_stats_table: Inset stats table inside the plot
annotation_move.connectors_between_marks: Connectors or zoom lines between marks
annotation_move.statistic_row_emphasis: Median or statistic row or block emphasised
annotation_move.input_or_base_case_marked: Input cells or base case marked

emphasis_device.bold_or_coloured_lead_in: Bold or coloured lead-in or key phrase
emphasis_device.single_emphasis_colour: Single emphasis colour on one item
emphasis_device.shaded_key_rows: Shaded key rows, cells or columns
emphasis_device.dark_label_cells_or_banners: Navy or dark label cells or banners
emphasis_device.arrow_connectors: Arrows, chevrons or wedges as connectors

number_format.units_line: Units line on the exhibit (A.3, A.9)
number_format.units_in_header: Units in a column or axis header (A.9)
number_format.currency_first_and_total_rows: $ only on the first and total rows (A.9)
number_format.nm_na_written: NM and NA written out, never blank (A.9)

legend.direct_labels: Series named on the marks (end or direct labels)
legend.swatch_text: Swatches with text in the series colour (A.6)
legend.none_needed: One series, or no series: nothing to name

colour_logic.single_hue_plus_highlight: Tints of one hue plus one "look here" colour (A.6)
colour_logic.single_hue: Tints of one hue, no highlight
colour_logic.semantic: Colour carries sign, status or heat (A.6)
